sentences.en: Hopefully you can rest and relax on the flight home.
sentences.zh: 希望你能在回家的航班上好好休息放松。

sentences.en: Before going home, I have a few drinks to relax.
sentences.zh: 回家前，我喝了几杯酒放松一下。

sentences.en: The locals around here really live at a relaxed pace.
sentences.zh: 这里的当地人生活节奏真的比较悠闲。

senses.zh: 放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（重新）+lax（松）→重新松开→（使）放松
